[[File:Piltz_1884_p40.png|thumb|300px|In Piltz's habilitation thesis (1884) the generalized Riemann hypothesis is mentioned.]]
'''Adolf Piltz''' (8 December 1855<ref>{{cite book |title=Dozenten-Album der Universität Jena: 1858 bis 1908 |page=25 |publisher=Neuenhahn |year=1908 }}</ref> – 1940) was a German [[mathematician]] who contributed to number theory. Piltz was arguably the first to formulate a [[generalized Riemann hypothesis]], in 1884.<ref>Davenport, p. 124.</ref>
